# Skills

<!-- generated by tools/skills.py; edit skills/<name>.md instead -->

Read this at the start of every session. When what the owner says matches a skill's "use when", read that skill's file and follow it. Several can apply in one session (a concern session may call investigate-repo and visualize). Fill parameters from what the owner said; ask only if one is missing. Don't make them name or copy a skill.

If a session shows a repeatable way of working that no skill covers, write one: see [write-skill](write-skill.md).

## Sessions (a whole conversation with a scope)

| Skill | Use when | Parameters |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [brand](brand.md) | The owner wants to work on a project's name, promise, voice or look ("the finance app needs a facelift", "serif or sans-serif?", "what should the camera app feel like?"), or the parent company's name. | project |
| [company-ceo](company-ceo.md) | The owner wants to think through a whole project: its thesis, customer, market, product and roadmap, or says "let's work on <project>" without a narrower topic. | project |
| [concern](concern.md) | The owner says they aren't confident about something, are worried about a feature, or wonder why a project stalled ("I don't trust the payments code", "the sync scares me"). | project, concern |
| [dump](dump.md) | The owner talks or pastes at length (20–50 minutes of speech, several projects at once, 30–100k characters) and wants it digested: stored, compressed, filed to the projects it touches, and turned into work. | none |
| [holding-review](holding-review.md) | The owner asks where their attention should go, what to pause or merge, or wants to look across all projects at once. | none |
| [identity](identity.md) | The owner wants to understand themself as a developer: their technologies, patterns, lessons, or how to talk about their work. | focus |
| [interview-practice](interview-practice.md) | The owner wants to practise interview questions about their work, rehearse explaining a project, prepare for a specific role, or debrief after an interview ("ask me about the finance app", "practise a recruiter call"). | project |
| [new-idea](new-idea.md) | The owner has a new idea, or wants to consolidate several ideas into one app instead of starting another. | idea |
| [re-entry](re-entry.md) | The owner wants to get back into a project they haven't touched in a while ("where was I with the time-tracking app?"). | project |
| [research](research.md) | The owner asks about the market, competitors, marketing, pricing, business model, past strategies, or whether a feature can pay for itself. | project, question |
| [resolution](resolution.md) | The owner wants to work down an open front or asks what it would take to fix something already recorded as a concern. | project, front |
| [shakedown](shakedown.md) | Trying out and refining Master-Repo itself during its first sessions. | none |
| [story](story.md) | The owner wants to write or rewrite why a project exists and where it's going, or a project has no wiki landing page yet. | project |

## Tasks (a focused job, often inside a session)

| Skill | Use when | Parameters |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [git-reading](git-reading.md) | A project's git history hasn't been read into its story, or it's time for the weekly git check. | project |
| [github-discovery](github-discovery.md) | The owner wants every repo inventoried so nothing is forgotten. | none |
| [investigate-repo](investigate-repo.md) | A concrete question needs an answer from a project's code (as its own job or inside another skill). | project, question |
| [migrate-legacy](migrate-legacy.md) | A project's company.json is mostly empty and archive notes exist for it. | project |
| [mockup-review](mockup-review.md) | A design question needs the owner's eye ("what could the phone app look like?", "mock up the end-of-shift screen", "draw it"), or any agent is about to make mockups, prototypes or design options for a project. | project, question |
| [rules-review](rules-review.md) | The owner asks to clean up, audit or trim the rules or lessons, or `tools/rules.py audit` or the refresh report says the last condense was over 30 days ago. | none |
| [screens](screens.md) | The owner wants to see where an app is at visually ("screenshot all of the finance app", "what does the camera app look like now", "map the screens"), a project has no screen map yet, or frontend work changed screens that need recapturing and review. | project |
| [tech-map](tech-map.md) | The owner wants to record what technologies and techniques a project shows. | project |
| [thread](thread.md) | The owner wants a direction weighed before deciding ("should the camera app go React Native?", "have the COO look into it", "what does the CEO think?"), wants to talk ideas or revisions through with a project's agent (one project or several), or a coding agent needs to report back to Master-Repo. | project, question |
| [vault-reading](vault-reading.md) | The owner points at their Obsidian notes, or a project's story, fronts or history are thin and their vault probably holds more. | project |
| [visualize](visualize.md) | The owner wants to see something in a new way (a chart, a model with sliders, a redesign), or research produced numbers worth showing. | project, what |
| [write-skill](write-skill.md) | A session revealed a repeatable way of working that no existing skill covers, a skill turned out wrong or incomplete, or the owner asks for a new skill. | what |
| [writing](writing.md) | Anything is being written that the owner will read (a story, a front, a wiki, research or idea page, a review, a git note, a thread message, app copy), or they say something reads as AI-written, wordy, or made up. | none |

## In a project repo (for agents coding in one of the owner's project repos)

| Skill | Use when | Parameters |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [project-session](project-session.md) | An agent is coding in one of the owner's project repos and the repo's CLAUDE.md / AGENTS.md points at Master-Repo. | project |
